svg.title: The Gaussian coordinate census p is the tubular coordinate count of that same block. The covariance upper bound M comes from its actual fluctuation covariance estimate. The warning event uses threshold t = ξ tfield/g, where g = β−1/2. Band comparability gives tfield/g at least one half of the fine monitor P. Put H = ε√P, ε = ξ/4. Eventually V2Bm ≤√P and M/2 ≤εP, because the monitor dominates the fixed covariance cost and the polynomial width cost. Hence M/2 + HV2Bm ≤2εP ≤t.
